assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina TruSeq Stranded Total RNA), SCN punches pooled 3-4 per biological replicate (FIG4, S4.14.p1)
primary_estimand: Effect of SCN-specific REV-ERBalpha/beta double knockout (SCN-DKO vs floxed control) on SCN gene expression, and the CT4-vs-CT16 circadian time difference within each genotype, in mice held 3 weeks in constant darkness (S2.3.p1). No exercise intervention is part of any RNA-seq experiment.
planned_contrasts: CT4 vs CT16 within control (S2.3.p1; paper: 807 DEGs)
CT4 vs CT16 within SCN-DKO (S2.3.p1; paper: 406 DEGs)
SCN-DKO vs control at CT4 (FIG4 E, S2.3.p2; paper: 286 DEGs, n=3 vs 3)
SCN-DKO vs control at ZT4 (FIG4 D, S2.3.p2; paper: 56 DEGs, n=2 vs 2; LD-housed samples, not in this series)
sample_inclusion: SCN of male control and SCN-DKO mice, 8-12 weeks, DD 3 weeks, harvested at CT4 or CT16 (S2.3.p1, S4 methods)
repeated_measure_unit: none; each replicate is a pool of 3-4 independent SCN punches from different animals (FIG4)

paper_threshold.source_locator: FIG4 B/D/E legend (FC > 1.5, FDR < 0.05, TPM > 0.1); S4.14.p1 (FDR < 0.05, > 0.1 TPM)

paper_method: STAR + featureCounts, TPM < 0.1 genes removed, DESeq2 (S4.14.p1)
exercise_role: Wheel running is used only as a readout of locomotor activity rhythm and free-running period (FIG1 C, FIG2 F, S4 methods S99/S103); it is not an experimental arm, and no RNA-seq sample is defined by exercise exposure.
